about.intro: "Lora Gate" LLC is an expert in developing and deploying automated continuous temperature and humidity monitoring systems for pharmaceutical and food warehouses, distribution centers and production facilities. We help businesses ensure cold chain continuity, protect valuable products from spoilage risks and strictly comply with national and international regulatory requirements (GxP, GDP, GMP, HACCP).
